questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

25 * 5 * 10 * 2 * 8 * 56
questions.solution:
We have to try the options on the given equation:

 25 * 5 * 10 * 2 * 8 * 56

Using **BODMAS** rule :-** Bracket of Division Multiplication Addition Subtraction.**

 Option 1) ÷, ×, +, –, =

25 ÷ 5 × 10 + 2 - 8 = 56

5 × 10 + 2 - 8 = 56

50 + 2 - 8 = 56

52 - 8 = 56

44 = 56 ** Incorrect**

Option 2) –, +, ÷, ×, =

25 - 5 + 10 ÷ 2 × 8 = 56

25 - 5 + 5 × 8 = 56

25 - 5 + 40 = 56

65 - 5 = 56

60 = 56 Incorrect

Option 3) ×, ÷, –, +, =

25 × 5 ÷ 10 - 2 + 8 = 56

25 × 0.5 - 2 + 8 = 56

12.5 - 2 + 8 = 56

20.5 - 2 = 56

18.5 = 56 Incorrect

Option 4) ÷, ×, –, +, =

25 ÷ 5 × 10 - 2 + 8 = 56

5 × 10 - 2 + 8 = 56

50 - 2 + 8 = 56

58 - 2 = 56

56 = 56 Correct

** **Hence **the correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: If 11 July 2020 was Monday, what will be 14 October 2028?
questions.solution:
Given: 11 July 2020 was Monday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Here, 11 July 2020 has been given as Monday - this does not match the original weekday of this date. Hence, the day on 14 October 2028 is also not similar to the original weekday.
 
• Therefore, 14 October 2028 will not be a Saturday if 11 July 2020 is a Monday.

So, 11 July to 14 October = 20(July) + 31(Aug) + 30(Sep) + 14(Oct) 

= 95 days = 95/7 = 13 weeks and 4 odd days.

So, 14 October 2020 = Monday + 4 = Friday.

Now, 

14 October 2020 to 14 October 2028 = 8 Years.

 
 

 Normal Year
 1 Odd day
 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd day
 
 

 

8 Years (6 Ordinary Year + 2 Leap Year) = 6 + 4 = 10 odd days.

10 odd days = 10/7 = 1 week 3 odd days.

So, 14 October 2028 = Friday + 3 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Monday"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

Year : 2028 - 2020 = 8 years + 2 leap years = 10 years , **odd days = 3 **

 Month: July-3, Aug-3, Sep-2 = 8 , **odd days =1** (Oct will not be counted)

Date: 22-14 = 8, **odd days = 1**

total odd days = 3 + 1 + 1 = 5 , **odd days = 0**

Therefore, **Monday + 0 = Monday** 

Hence, **the correct answer is Monday.**

questions.question:
Two different poritions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. What is the sum of the numbers that are opposite '5' and '1' ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de0ecf9d82430c70103123bc309ee8969cd90e3bc9d78c9590fdd5e1386355db.png]
questions.solution:
In a standard dice the faces 2 and 5 are opposite & 3 and 4 are opposite & 1 and 6 are opposite to each other.

The side opposites to each other in a dice are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de0ecf9d82430c70103123bc309ee8969cd90e3bc9d78c9590fdd5e1386355db.png] 

The dice is turned to it's right keeping the face '1' at the same position.

We found that '3' is to the right of '5' and '4' is to the left of '5'. Thus, 3 is opposite to 4.

Therefore **5 is opposite to 2.**

The only two faces left are '1' and '6'. So **1 is opposite to 6.**

 

So the sum of side opposite to 5 and 1 is: 

 Side opposite to 5 + side opposite to 1 =** 6 + 2 = 8 **

Hence **the correct answer is 8.**

questions.question: Seven friends A,B,C,D,E,F and G, each has a different height. A is shorter than B but taller than C. B is taller than only four others. E is taller than G but shorter than C. D is taller than B but shorter than F. Who is the tallest among all?
questions.solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: A is shorter than B but taller than C.

⇒ B > A > C​

Step 2: E is taller than G but shorter than C.

⇒ C > E > G

Step 3: D is taller than B but shorter than F.

⇒ F > D > B

Combining the given information:

⇒ F > D > B > A > C > E > G

So, **F is the tallest.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All pillows are beds.

No table is a bed.

Some tables are chairs.

**Conclusions:**

I. No pillow is a table.

II. Some chairs are pillows.

III. No bed is a chair.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
Lets see the statements;

All pillows are beds.

No table is a bed.

Some tables are chairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dfab9345a97bec194c0078903cf3363fc88d529f8bcea44f0b31456d2a50d4b.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:

**I. No pillow is a table: **From the diagram and the given statement we can say that there is no relation between pillow and table and thus we can say that no pillow is a table. So the conclusion follow.

**II. Some chairs are pillows: **From the diagram and the given statement we can say that there is no relation between pillow and chairs also chairs are not related to bed so there is no possibility and thus we cannot say that some chairs are pillows. So the conclusion does not follow.

**III. No bed is a chair: **There is no information that relates bed with chairs and we already know chairs are not related to pillows either so there is no connection that leads us to this conclusion and therefore this conclusion does not follow.

Since only conclusion I follows.

Hence **the correct answer is option 2)**

That is (11+3=14, FROM FIRST ROW)

questions.question: In a certain code language, “AN” is coded as “16”, and “NO” is coded as “212”. How will “US” be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Coded word = (Positional value of 1st letter) × (Positional value of 2nd letter) + 2**

 
• In AN → 16 

 
 
• Positional value of A and N = 1 and 14
 
• Hence, coded word = (1 × 14) + 2 = 14 + 2 = 16
 
 
 
• In NO → 212 
 
 
• Positional value of N and O = 14 and 15
 
• Hence, coded word = (14 × 15) + 2 = 210 + 2 = 212
 
 
 
• Similarly, **US** → ? 
 
 
• Positional value of U and S = 21 and 19
 
• Hence, coded word = (21 × 19) + 2 = 399 + 2 = **401**
 
 

Hence, Option 3) is the correct answer.
